evidence: Owned production PostgreSQL 13 for the lending platform: schema design, indexing and query plan reviews for all teams

Set up streaming replication, PgBouncer and nightly backups with tested restores

strengths: Deep Postgres ownership incl. operations our compose.yml lacks
